title: The Golden Calf
summary: Idols are false helps that pull hearts away from the living God. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Exodus 32:1-14 and look for how this passage teaches: Idols are false helps that pull hearts away from the living God.

tell_it: While Moses was on the mountain, the people made a golden calf. They forgot the God who had rescued them.
understand_it: Idols are false helps that pull hearts away from the living God. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: The Golden Calf reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Idols matters.
age_8_11_explanation: The Golden Calf shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: Idols are false helps that pull hearts away from the living God.
teen_explanation: The Golden Calf gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that idols are false helps that pull hearts away from the living God. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: Idols are false helps that pull hearts away from the living God.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when idols is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: What did the people make?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: A golden calf. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that idols are false helps that pull hearts away from the living God.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Exodus 32:4 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in The Golden Calf?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: True Worship Sort
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: Idols are false helps that pull hearts away from the living God.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from The Golden Calf. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
